     }
 
+    const countResult = await this.db.query<{ count: string }>(

+      [agentType]

+
+    if (aliveCount >= this.maxSessionsPerType) {
+      await this.db.query(

+        [agentType]

+
     const result = await this.db.query<{ generate_bot_id: string }>(
